How We Work  /  Access & Discounts

Good technology help should not be the thing you cannot afford.

Who this is for

Nonprofits

Any 501(c)(3) with an annual operating budget under $2M. Larger organizations get 15%.

30% off our rate

Marginalized-owned businesses

Businesses majority-owned by BIPOC, women, LGBTQ+, immigrant, veteran, or disabled Mainers. You pick the point on the scale.

sliding scale $60–$140 / hr

Pro bono hours

Set aside for organizations and one-person shops where any rate would be the reason they went without.

20 hours / quarter

Payment plans

Any invoice can be split across up to three months. Ask before or after — it does not change the price.

no interest

How to ask

Just say so

On the first call, tell us the reduced rate is what you need. That is the whole process.

No application

No documentation

We do not ask for tax returns, budgets, or proof of who owns what. We take your word for it.

No paperwork

Same work, same people

A reduced rate does not buy you a junior version of us. It is the same work, scheduled the same way.

No difference

Why we do it this way

Every hour of technology help we give away comes back as a food pantry that can take appointments, or a shop that gets paid on time. We would rather be busy and useful than fully billable.

Tell us what you need.

If the rate is the obstacle, say that first and we will work backward from what you can do.

Start a conversation

Technology help for people, and their businesses, organizations, and communities.
